1533801.name: Weapon 02
1533801.description: Fires lasers, dealing damage to the Nikke with the highest ATK.

1533802.name: Weapon 03
1533802.description: Fires Dark Matter, dealing damage to the Nikke with the lowest ATK.

1533803.name: Weapon 03-01
1533803.description: Fires Dark Matter spikes, dealing damage to a single Nikke. The spikes can be intercepted.

1533804.name: Weapon 04
1533804.description: Collects Dark Matter and fires it as a laser, dealing damage to all Nikkes.

1533805.name: Weapon 04-02
1533805.description:
Surrounds itself entirely with Dark Matter before scattering that Dark Matter in a burst, dealing lethal damage to all Nikkes.
The Goddess of Victory statue generates a code barrier to defend against attacks while using Weapon 04-02. While the barrier is up, only Fire Code Nikkes can deal damage.

1533806.name: Weapon 04-03
1533806.description: Surrounds itself entirely with Dark Matter before scattering that Dark Matter in a burst. This attack must be interrupted via Special Interruption; otherwise, it deals lethal damage to all Nikkes.

1533809.name: Temporary Sequence 01
1533809.description: Fires masses of Dark Matter, dealing damage to Nikkes. The masses can be intercepted with a certain number of hits.

1533810.name: Temporary Sequence 02
1533810.description: Detonates Dark Matter spheres, dealing damage to a single Nikke.

1533811.name: Temporary Sequence 03
1533811.description: The Goddess of Victory attacks with both hands and then shoots lasers, dealing damage to all Nikkes.

1533812.name: Temporary Sequence 04
1533812.description: The Goddess of Victory shoots multiple spikes, dealing damage to all Nikkes.
